name: Vercel
summary: Cloud platform for deploying web apps.

flows.title: Deploy a Git repository as a new project
steps: Click the New Project button at the top right of the dashboard.
Pick the repository from the list your connected Git providers offer. The dropdown at the top left of the list switches to another Git namespace or provider.
On the configuration page, adjust the project's name, Framework Preset, root directory and Build Output Settings as needed.

flows.title: Add a custom domain to a project
steps: On the dashboard, pick the project, open Settings in the sidebar, and select Domains.
Click Add Domain and enter the domain. For an apex domain such as example.com, Vercel prompts you to add the www subdomain too.
Configure the domain's DNS records with your registrar the way the dashboard shows: an A record for an apex domain, a CNAME record for a subdomain, or Vercel's nameservers.
Once Vercel has verified the domain, its status in the dashboard shows it is ready for use.

flows.title: Roll back a production deployment
steps: On the project's overview page, click Instant Rollback on the Production Deployment tile.
Select the deployment to roll back to and click Continue. On Pro and Enterprise plans, Choose another deployment lists every eligible one.
Verify the domains and subdomains that will be rolled back, then click Confirm Rollback.
Vercel then stops assigning production domains to new pushes. To undo, click Undo Rollback on the same tile, select the deployment to promote and click Confirm.
